title: SAM OS INT8 Matrix Multiply — Tiled 4x32 x 32x4

matmul_engine.function: sam_int8_matmul(A, B_T, C, M, K, N)
matmul_engine.implementation: kernel/simd.h — M*N calls to sam_int8_dot(), each of length K
matmul_engine.layout: Row-major. B must be pre-transposed so B_T[j][k] = B[k][j], enabling contiguous dot product per output element.

boot_output: [SAM OS] Sprint 4 PASS -- INT8 matmul on bare metal

significance.what_this_is: sam_int8_matmul() is the exact operation at the core of every transformer layer: Q*K^T attention scores, attention*V output projection, and FFN weight projections. The 4x32x32x4 shape mirrors a transformer with head_dim=32, batch=4.
significance.what_this_proves: SAM OS can execute inference-scale INT8 matrix multiply on bare metal on a 2010-era CPU with no GPU, no OS overhead, no libc. The kernel IS the inference engine.
significance.path_to_real_inference: Scale K to 128/256/512 → load real GGUF weight matrices into AI domain → run token generation loop

domain_vision.updated: SAM OS is a full OS for old hardware — not just AI+Game. Three domains: AI (inference), GAME (60fps deadline), GENERAL (lightweight apps). Hardware-honest scheduler: one heavy workload at a time, others yield. Positioned for India's low-cost hardware base and indigenous OS initiative.
domain_vision.sprint8_goal: Add GENERAL domain (0x30) + basic app runtime alongside AI/Game scheduler
